status: Read-only source audit completed before new all79 result interpretation

paper_confirmed.section: Methods / Decoding analyses; main text DMFC Population dynamics; Figure 3C-F caption
paper_confirmed.static_head: One time-invariant regression over pooled condition x time rows; train and test conditions disjoint within each split
paper_confirmed.fit_epoch: Full visible plus occluded trial, with the same readout used across both phases
paper_confirmed.cross_validation: 50% of conditions for training, 100 train/test splits, except Supplementary Figure S4A
paper_confirmed.metrics: Pearson correlation and root mean squared error
paper_confirmed.independence: Methods explicitly do not treat pooled condition x time rows as independent observations

official_implementation.choice: OLS LinearRegression() defaults; fit_intercept=True, no regularization, no sample_weight
No feature standardization in the none preprocessing branch; no target standardization

Current GitHub wrapper requests 33 outputs. Released Fig3 saved-author results actually used 23 outputs, as recorded in verified reproduction summaries for both animals and pooled data. Prior reproduction explicitly takes saved_author_result[beh_to_decode] before the wrapper default. New all79 uses the released 23-output joint finite-row mask; xy columns are still separable OLS outputs.

n_splits=100 from wrapper, train_size=0.5, random_state=0 from decoder default; groups are original condition array indices. For 79 conditions, each split contains 39 training and 40 testing conditions

occ is a task category; zero-lag source mask start_end_pad0_roll0 and target start_end_pad0; matched_timepoints=True. No padded samples or temporal history added. No alignment shift during fitting; realignment is a plotting operation

Unweighted pooled held-out condition x time Pearson r per output, then nanmean and nanstd(ddof=0) over overlapping splits. Longer conditions contribute more rows. This is not an average of per-condition r or the r of averaged predictions

RMSE_x=sqrt(MSE_x), RMSE_y=sqrt(MSE_y), 2D RMSE=sqrt(MSE_x+MSE_y), no division by two. Figure time courses average squared error across held-out conditions at each aligned time and summarize these splitwise RMSEs
Published reliable-unit FA50 factors are fit to full-mean responses across all conditions outside readout CV. This is not training-only preprocessing. Published half factors are fit independently

implementation_caveats: Original finite 50ms masks can overlap at the visible-hidden boundary and include partial terminal bins. Local official reproduction had 3502 valid condition-time rows; the prior conservative pilot support had 3423. New GPFA/common-label support must be reported as an adaptation, not falsely restored by padding or imputation.

Figure 3 caption says mean +/- SEM, whereas the current official helper uses nanstd across overlapping splits. This version explicitly reports SD and does not interpret the 100 splits as independent experiments.
The helper computes mse_mu but omits it from its intermediate returned dictionary (decoding_summary.py:157,167,171-175). Direct explicit RMSE computation is necessary.

Figure 3 caption names a two-sided permutation test; Methods also mention scipy pearsonr p values. Current helper calls wilcoxon on hidden scores alone (line608), not a visible-hidden paired comparison. This version does not inherit these calls as a test of phase equivalence.
Official figure start-aligned time index begins at zero; new causal-latent plots use bin right-edge availability times in ms and label that convention explicitly.

All79 frozen GPFA64 analysis adapts the official downstream OLS scheme. Some readout test conditions were used for original GPFA fitting, so it is readout-condition holdout on a frozen representation, not full-pipeline unseen-condition generalization. Half1-fitted heads applied to half2 also differ from the published full-mean FA50 input.
